description: Official executive, standards, civil-rights, consumer-protection, and health-regulation sources for U.S. AI governance.

source_portals.name: White House Presidential Actions
source_portals.coverage_notes: Executive orders and presidential directives that shape federal AI policy.

source_portals.name: White House Releases
source_portals.coverage_notes: Fact sheets, policy announcements, and implementation updates tied to AI governance.

source_portals.name: NIST Artificial Intelligence
source_portals.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology
source_portals.coverage_notes: Federal technical standards, frameworks, and implementation resources for trustworthy AI.

source_portals.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
source_portals.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology
source_portals.coverage_notes: Framework pages, profiles, and playbooks for AI risk management.

source_portals.name: OSTP AI Bill of Rights
source_portals.issuing_body: White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official White House OSTP materials on rights-protective AI governance, including the Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights and companion implementation guidance.

source_portals.name: FTC AI Policy and Reports
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official FTC reports and policy materials addressing consumer protection, bias, surveillance, and deceptive or unfair AI practices.

source_portals.name: Interagency AI Enforcement Statement
source_portals.issuing_body: Department of Justice / EEOC / FTC / CFPB
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official interagency civil-rights, consumer-protection, and equal-opportunity materials on unlawful discrimination and bias in automated systems.

source_portals.name: FDA AI-Enabled Medical Device Guidance
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official FDA guidance and supporting materials for AI-enabled medical devices, including premarket, lifecycle, and change-control expectations.

source_portals.name: CFPB AI and Algorithmic Finance
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official CFPB circulars and research reports on algorithmic credit decisions, chatbot deployment, and AI-related consumer-finance harms.

source_portals.name: Federal Register — Presidential Documents & AI/SI Rulemaking
source_portals.coverage_notes: Authoritative federal gazette for Executive Orders (EO 14409, EO 14434, Dec 2025 National Policy Framework EO) and federal AI/Super Intelligence rulemaking.

source_portals.name: NIST Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) / Super Intelligence Portal
source_portals.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST / CAISI)
source_portals.coverage_notes: Official portal for NIST CAISI frontier evaluations, the 2026 AI/SI Agent Standards Initiative, NCCoE agent-IAM concept papers, and CSRC Cyber AI Profile (NIST IR 8596).

source_portals.name: GovInfo Public Laws (U.S. Congress)
source_portals.issuing_body: U.S. Government Publishing Office / U.S. Congress
source_portals.coverage_notes: Canonical federal statutory repository for enacted U.S. AI legislation (e.g., TAKE IT DOWN Act, Pub. L. 119-12).

seed_documents.title: Executive Order 14409: Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security (91 FR 34565)
seed_documents.issuing_body: Executive Office of the President
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Signed June 2, 2026 (published 91 FR 34565, June 5, 2026). Establishes federal AI cybersecurity clearinghouse and voluntary 30-day pre-release federal evaluation access for frontier developers while rejecting mandatory federal licensing.

seed_documents.title: Executive Order 14434: Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence (91 FR 63129)
seed_documents.issuing_body: Executive Office of the President
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Signed September 29, 2026 (published 91 FR 63129, October 2, 2026). Directs executive agencies to adopt 'Super Intelligence (SI)' nomenclature across official non-statutory documents and portals; major federal strategic framing pivot.

seed_documents.title: Executive Order 14365: Ensuring a National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence (90 FR 58499)
seed_documents.issuing_body: Executive Office of the President
seed_documents.relevance_notes: Signed December 11, 2025 (published 90 FR 58499, December 16, 2025). Establishes DOJ task force addressing state AI regulatory fragmentation and ties broadband/federal funding to uniform national framework principles.

seed_documents.title: TAKE IT DOWN Act (Public Law 119-12, 139 Stat. 55)
seed_documents.issuing_body: U.S. Congress
seed_documents.relevance_notes: First binding U.S. federal AI deepfake / nonconsensual intimate imagery criminal and platform notice-and-takedown statute (139 Stat. 55); FTC 48-hour takedown enforcement entered into force May 19, 2026.

seed_documents.title: NIST CAISI / SI Agent Standards Initiative
seed_documents.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST / CAISI)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: 2026 NIST Center for AI / SI Standards and Innovation initiative establishing technical standards for autonomous AI agent identity, authentication, interoperability, and security.

seed_documents.title: NIST IR 8596 (Initial Preliminary Draft): Cybersecurity Framework Profile for Artificial Intelligence (Cyber AI Profile)
seed_documents.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
seed_documents.relevance_notes: 107-page NIST IR 8596 Initial Preliminary Draft community profile mapping NIST CSF 2.0 controls to securing AI systems, conducting AI-enabled cyber defense, and thwarting AI-enabled cyber threats. Quarantined as draft_consultation until final publication.
